topIssues.title: postinstall script fails: scripts/install-ollama.js not included in published tarball
topIssues.author: edcet
topIssues.body:
## Problem

`bun pm trust --all` fails globally because this package's postinstall script errors:

```
error: Module not found "scripts/install-ollama.js"
error: postinstall script from "@elizaos/plugin-ollama" exited with 1
```

This blocks `bun pm trust --all` for the entire global install, preventing all other packages from being trusted.

## Root Cause

`package.json` declares:
```json
"postinstall": "bun scripts/install-ollama.js"
```

But the `files` field is:
```json
"files": ["typescript/dist", "README.md", "python", "rust/src", "rust/Cargo.toml"]
```

The `scripts/` directory is not in `files`, so it is excluded from the published npm tarball. The file exists in the repo at tag `v1.2.4` (confirmed via GitHub API) but is not shipped to npm.

## Impact

The postinstall script (`scripts/install-ollama.js`) checks if Ollama is installed and pulls the `nomic-embed-text` model. It is non-critical — the plugin functions without it. The script also skips in CI environments (`CI=true`).

However, because `bun pm trust --all` stops at the first error, this blocks trust for all other untrusted packages in the same global install.

## Workaround

Set `CI=true` before running trust:
```bash
CI=true bun pm -g trust --all
```

Or trust packages individually, skipping this one.

## Fix

Add `scripts` to the `files` field:
```json
"files": ["typescript/dist", "README.md", "python", "rust/src", "rust/Cargo.toml", "scripts"]
```

Note: there is an existing branch `fix/ollama-install-script-ci` but it does not appear to address this specific issue (its `files` field is `["dist"]` and still declares the postinstall script).

## Environment

- bun 1.3.11
- @elizaos/plugin-ollama 1.2.4
- macOS arm64
